newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary plans to sell 83.66 pct in Mezobank.
newsitem.headline: Hungary plans to sell 83.66 pct in Mezobank.

text.p: Hungary's state privatisation agency APV said on Wednesday that it would invite three foreign investors to a tender for the sale of a 83.66 percent stake in Mezobank, pending a government approval on Thursday.

"If the government approves tomorrow that Mezobank can be privatised, APV will invite strategic investors on July 1 to a closed one-round tender for an 83.66 percent stake in the bank," APV Managing Director Gabor Nemeth told a news conference.
Nemeth said that APV would invite two Austrian banks to the tender and also a bank from an English-speaking country.
He declined to name the investors.
